title: Raycast closing call to action
description: A tall dark closer: a cropped keyboard whose rows dim into the page at the top, with one modifier key and the space bar glowing red (a slow breathing loop), then a centred two-tone heading, the light download button and two small mono lines. On phones the keyboard shrinks to about 40% and the button is dropped.
notes: the board is the raycast-keyboard component; light keys with `lit: true`
the breathing glow stops under reduced motion
